defects.title: Image alt text is required for saving or publishing
defects.bad_fingerprint: A news item with valid images but no alt fails validation or publication
defects.expected: Image descriptions are optional for cover, image blocks and galleries without weakening image validation or removing existing text.

defects.title: Whole-site draft preview entry is missing on mobile
defects.bad_fingerprint: The mobile breakpoint hides the topbar preview link and the sidebar has no equivalent link
defects.expected: All authenticated roles can open whole-site draft preview from the mobile menu, with unsaved changes protected and no anonymous entry.

defects.title: Migration problems do not show the evidence used for their diagnosis
defects.bad_fingerprint: A conflicting album date shows only a short technical message and omits the title, saved date and differing years in the legacy URL
defects.expected: Show the actual values and their sources with an understandable next step; never present missing or current data as historical evidence.

defects.title: Mobile sidebar stays open after choosing a management section
defects.bad_fingerprint: Tapping Migration selects the panel but leaves cms-menu-open on body and the sidebar over the content
defects.expected: Every accepted navigation closes the mobile sidebar; canceling unsaved navigation preserves the editor and menu

defects.title: Preparation discards the source text needed to retain an album date conflict
defects.bad_fingerprint: Removing body_text erases conflicting day evidence so repeated preparation proposes unplanned date metadata
defects.expected: Preserve the source evidence for unresolved date conflicts and obtain a stable repeatable preparation.

defects.title: Valid saved album date is ignored when the legacy URL contains no year
defects.bad_fingerprint: A saved 2024-10-06 album with /20241/ in its legacy URL is sent for editorial date review although the full date is valid
defects.expected: Use the saved date when the URL contains no recognizable year; preserve placeholder and conflicting evidence protections.

defects.title: CMS domain root redirect sends draft-site preview back to editor
defects.bad_fingerprint: Production nginx redirects the exact root of cms.temple.gbvolkoff.name to /cms.html and drops preview=drafts before the application sees it.
defects.expected: A protected non-root home endpoint and all preview home links stay on the authenticated CMS origin and render the public site through the unchanged production proxy.

defects.title: Draft-site entry leaves the user in the CMS tab
defects.bad_fingerprint: The preview link targets a new tab; the current tab remains the editor, and some browser hosts do not foreground the new page.
defects.expected: A normal click opens the real public-site layout with saved drafts in the current tab for every CMS role; unsaved work is protected.

defects.title: Draft preview can reuse a cached public script without read-only controls
defects.bad_fingerprint: preview HTML requests the same unversioned app.js URL previously cached by the normal site, so an old browser script may omit disabling preview forms and preserving preview navigation
defects.expected: draft-preview HTML uses content-versioned script and stylesheet URLs while ordinary public URLs remain stable

defects.title: Draft-preview exit link keeps the preview parameter
defects.bad_fingerprint: link rewriting checks only attributes preceding href and re-adds preview=drafts to an exit anchor whose data-preview-exit follows href
defects.expected: exit links leave preview mode independently of HTML attribute order, while ordinary navigation retains the parameter

defects.title: Reconciliation rejects social-preview derivatives generated by the CMS
defects.bad_fingerprint: a valid social/site-v1.jpg produced by server.seo is classified invalid and blocks the production migration preflight
defects.expected: recognize site and revision social-card namespaces while still rejecting malformed paths and orphan revision cards

defects.title: Production baseline omits runtime missing-media reports
defects.bad_fingerprint: the archive restores the production manifest and 202 missing-media issues but omits data/missing-legacy-media.csv, causing reconciliation against an obsolete 201-row checkout report
defects.expected: baseline archives and checksums runtime CSV and Markdown missing-media reports; restore verification detects missing or changed files

defects.title: Policy analysis includes native incomplete album drafts outside migration
defects.bad_fingerprint: an active native album with no legacy identity and no migration flag enters the policy scope solely because its draft date is incomplete
defects.expected: only existing migration records or albums with a legacy identity may be added to policy scope; native drafts stay untouched

defects.title: Gallery preparation demands review of crawl text absent from the gallery schema
defects.bad_fingerprint: a gallery containing crawl navigation is classified editorial_review due solely to text_extraction_ambiguous even though body is not an editable or public gallery field
defects.expected: only schema-defined body fields require text-boundary review; every album photo is preserved

defects.title: Source-data snapshots require hardlinks unavailable in restricted Windows environments
defects.bad_fingerprint: copytree(copy_function=os.link) raises WinError 5 and prevents every reconciliation/preparation source-data check
defects.expected: snapshot copies fall back to copy2 while preserving the source and file timestamps

defects.title: CMS assets do not require revalidation after a deployment
defects.bad_fingerprint: CMS HTML, script, styles and schema have no explicit revalidation policy
defects.expected: editor assets require caches to revalidate before reuse

defects.title: Editor remains interactive while the selected material loads
defects.bad_fingerprint: a delayed content response allows editing the previous form and can discard input
defects.expected: form controls are disabled until the selected record finishes loading

defects.title: Source-data tests read the manifest from the checkout instead of the source
defects.bad_fingerprint: isolated release checkout reports an empty manifest despite a complete external source
defects.expected: source-data profile uses the provided source manifest and verifies its integrity

defects.title: Source integrity comparison misses changes that preserve counts
defects.bad_fingerprint: source report remains equal after content changes without changing aggregate counts
defects.expected: source comparison detects logical changes to database rows

defects.title: Semantic gate does not detect content hash drift
defects.bad_fingerprint: content changes without a version increment after the audit
defects.expected: semantic gate rejects a mismatched content hash

defects.title: Card review misses content hash drift
defects.bad_fingerprint: card shows prior audit after content changed without a new version
defects.expected: card marks the audit stale when its stored content hash differs

defects.title: Batch finalization bypasses a stale global semantic gate
defects.bad_fingerprint: a batch finalizes while another changed material invalidates the full audit
defects.expected: finalization requires a current global semantic gate

defects.title: Finalizing an editorial batch does not invalidate the full gate
defects.bad_fingerprint: semantic gate remains ready after batch changes the audit population
defects.expected: another full audit is required after an editorial batch

defects.title: Follow-up batches bypass a stale global semantic gate
defects.bad_fingerprint: a batch can be created after a local edit invalidates the full post-apply audit
defects.expected: batch creation requires a current full semantic gate

defects.title: A stale save does not offer to load the current version
defects.bad_fingerprint: 409 leaves the editor without a direct recovery action
defects.expected: editor retains unsaved input and can choose to open the newer version

defects.title: Final verification misses current blockers introduced after its audit
defects.bad_fingerprint: final gate trusts stale audit counts despite a current open blocker
defects.expected: final verification checks current unresolved blockers as well as audit totals

defects.title: Semantic gate can miss current issues from later audits
defects.bad_fingerprint: a later audit moves issue ownership and the semantic gate overlooks the issue
defects.expected: all current unresolved issues are checked regardless of the latest audit that observed them

defects.title: Card hides a failed latest audit behind an older result
defects.bad_fingerprint: failed latest audit is displayed as a completed older check
defects.expected: failed or running audit is visible and no clean counts are shown

defects.title: Final verification does not require a fresh active-content audit
defects.bad_fingerprint: no final gate verifies active content versions and blockers
defects.expected: final verification fails closed until the full active-content audit is current and clean

defects.title: Final audit skips accepted active content
defects.bad_fingerprint: accepted drafts are absent from the audit population
defects.expected: final audit explicitly scans active content after acceptance

defects.title: A card audit does not create a versioned assessment
defects.bad_fingerprint: card review has no current-version assessment
defects.expected: each single-card audit stores an immutable assessment linked to its version and audit

defects.title: Automatically ready records cannot be accepted automatically
defects.bad_fingerprint: auto_ready records remain flagged and cannot enter editorial batches
defects.expected: verified records are accepted as drafts with an idempotent operation journal and rollback

defects.title: A stale batch cannot be refreshed after an edit
defects.bad_fingerprint: edited materials leave their batch unusable
defects.expected: publishers can refresh a stale batch and reconfirm only changed decisions

defects.title: Follow-up batches cannot be selected by title
defects.bad_fingerprint: no candidate lookup for a follow-up batch
defects.expected: publishers can find selectable and excluded materials with reasons

defects.title: Batch creation does not freeze the selected versions
defects.bad_fingerprint: changed content enters a batch after selection
defects.expected: batch creation rejects changed selections atomically

defects.title: Stale mass preview remains actionable
defects.bad_fingerprint: summary exposes completed preview after content version changes
defects.expected: stale previews are unavailable before apply

defects.title: Card does not expose persistent audit or local Unicode correction
defects.bad_fingerprint: card review and correction endpoints are unavailable
defects.expected: current audit and role-protected versioned local correction remain available after reload

defects.title: Clergy position can be saved without Unicode normalization
defects.bad_fingerprint: saving position with a nonbreaking space stores non-NFKC text
defects.expected: clergy position is NFKC-normalized when saved without changing other fields

defects.title: Migration acceptance is incomplete
defects.bad_fingerprint: review_required > 0
defects.expected: review_required == 0

defects.title: Missing-media report and CMS queue disagree
defects.bad_fingerprint: report > 0 and CMS queue == 0
defects.expected: report and CMS queue reconcile

defects.title: Unsaved changes are lost without confirmation
defects.bad_fingerprint: dirty title disappears on navigation
defects.expected: explicit save/discard/stay decision

defects.title: Incomplete media blocks produce raw 422 errors
defects.bad_fingerprint: preview returns 422
defects.expected: local validation and preserved preview

defects.title: Media chooser state and visible filters diverge
defects.bad_fingerprint: visible usage empty while request contains usage=used
defects.expected: DOM and request state match

defects.title: Revoked session does not reopen login
defects.bad_fingerprint: 401 leaves login dialog closed
defects.expected: 401 returns UI to login

defects.title: Password and logout controls are unavailable on mobile
defects.bad_fingerprint: both controls hidden at 390px
defects.expected: account actions remain reachable

defects.title: Pilot before audit produces an unhandled 409
defects.bad_fingerprint: enabled pilot action returns 409
defects.expected: disabled action with explanation

defects.title: New material retains old picker state
defects.bad_fingerprint: search or review filter remains active
defects.expected: new material resets picker state

defects.title: Closed login dialog cannot be reopened
defects.bad_fingerprint: no visible login control
defects.expected: persistent login entry point

defects.title: Username HTML pattern is invalid in Chromium
defects.bad_fingerprint: a!b passes browser validity
defects.expected: browser rejects invalid username

defects.title: Skip link does not move focus
defects.bad_fingerprint: hash changes but editor is not focused
defects.expected: focus moves to #editor

defects.title: Migration search ignores issue code
defects.bad_fingerprint: known code query returns total=0
defects.expected: known code query returns matching issues

defects.title: Migration refresh responses can race
defects.bad_fingerprint: delayed old query overwrites the newer result
defects.expected: stale responses cannot render

defects.title: Required field semantics are not explained
defects.bad_fingerprint: draft readiness explanation absent
defects.expected: draft/save/review requirements are explicit

defects.title: Settings panel contains only schema version
defects.bad_fingerprint: database/media/migration diagnostics absent
defects.expected: diagnostic system information is visible

defects.title: Reindex has no measurable progress
defects.bad_fingerprint: no numeric progress during reindex
defects.expected: processed/total or percent is visible

defects.title: 100-item selector limit is not explained
defects.bad_fingerprint: total exceeds options without hint or pagination
defects.expected: limit is explained or list is pageable

defects.title: Server tests emit Starlette deprecation warning
defects.bad_fingerprint: warning-as-error pytest run fails
defects.expected: warning-as-error pytest run passes

defects.title: Gallery cover repeated as its first photo is reported as a duplicate
defects.bad_fingerprint: duplicate_media_reference is open when cover equals photos[0].image
defects.expected: duplicates are detected only within the same repeatable media field

defects.title: Automatic preparation leaves non-NFKC text in auto-ready materials
defects.bad_fingerprint: 197 auto_ready materials retain unicode_not_nfkc after apply; 486 such issues remain overall
defects.expected: all prepared materials have zero unicode_not_nfkc issues after apply

defects.title: Preparation verification succeeds despite post-apply audit violations
defects.bad_fingerprint: verify returns ok with 590 blockers and 1016 warnings in the current post-apply audit
defects.expected: verify fails closed on absent, stale, incomplete or semantically inconsistent post-apply audit and accepts fully mapped editorial results

defects.title: Media mirror does not retry transient network failures
defects.bad_fingerprint: one WinError 10060 remains in the manifest although the public URL immediately returns HTTP 200
defects.expected: transient failures use bounded retries while permanent 404/410 are recorded without retry

defects.title: Source-bundle validator is invoked as a file and cannot import server
defects.bad_fingerprint: python scripts/validate_source_bundle.py fails with ModuleNotFoundError: server after media mirroring
defects.expected: all Windows and Ubuntu rollout scripts invoke scripts.validate_source_bundle as a module

defects.title: Unsealed Windows source bundle cannot resume after a late failure
defects.bad_fingerprint: late validation failure forces a new crawl and redownload of more than 13,000 mirrored files
defects.expected: explicit resume reuses checkpoint and verified mirrored entries but refuses sealed bundles

defects.title: Crawler leaves remaining_queue stale when duplicate tail entries drain the queue
defects.bad_fingerprint: queue is empty and final log says remaining=0, but checkpoint retains remaining_queue=24 and fails bundle validation
defects.expected: final checkpoint always synchronizes remaining_queue with the actual queue length

defects.title: Ubuntu clean deployment validator depends on undeclared host Python packages
defects.bad_fingerprint: clean bootstrap fails before import with ModuleNotFoundError: pypdfium2 on a documented Ubuntu host
defects.expected: source-bundle validation runs inside the already built application image with pinned runtime dependencies

defects.title: Valid static legacy GIF files block automatic migration preparation
defects.bad_fingerprint: 36 mirrored single-frame GIF files are indexed as invalid and produce one technical_blocker material
defects.expected: verified static GIF files under legacy/ are indexed as ready while user GIF uploads remain rejected

defects.title: Valid mirrored image with a historical extension mismatch is indexed as invalid
defects.bad_fingerprint: a valid PNG payload mirrored from a public .jpg URL is stored as invalid although its bytes and SHA-256 are intact
defects.expected: verified legacy JPG/PNG/WebP payloads are indexed by detected format with mismatch provenance while user uploads remain extension-strict

defects.title: Clean deployment proceeds when media reconciliation reports unexplained warnings
defects.bad_fingerprint: production cutover completed with reconciliation status=warning, invalid_files=1 and unexplained_count=1
defects.expected: bootstrap and post-activation verify both fail closed unless media reconciliation status is ok and unexplained_count is zero

defects.title: Legacy treby list is imported but has no public section or correct redirect
defects.bad_fingerprint: /требы-онлайн.html is treated as an index and redirects to / while the imported page has no treby placement
defects.expected: the imported page is placed at treby_info and the legacy URL redirects to /treby

defects.title: Production rollout requires interactive sudo despite direct Docker access
defects.bad_fingerprint: baseline and rollout scripts hard-code sudo docker and cleanup hard-codes sudo rm, so the docker-group deployment user cannot run non-interactively
defects.expected: deployment scripts prefer verified direct Docker access, fall back to passwordless sudo, and clean disposable restore data without an interactive prompt

defects.title: Submission detail assertion races the asynchronous detail request
defects.bad_fingerprint: the test reads the previous submission detail immediately after clicking a new row and intermittently fails although the requested card renders moments later
defects.expected: the regression waits for the selected submission reference before checking its protected fields

defects.title: Production baseline cannot checkpoint a root-owned SQLite database
defects.bad_fingerprint: the service stops and host sqlite3 fails with attempt to write a readonly database because the container owns cms.sqlite3 and its WAL
defects.expected: after stopping the service, baseline checkpoints SQLite through the verified runtime image while retaining host-side read-only integrity and backup checks

defects.title: Baseline report omits the published-pointer invariant required by rollout
defects.bad_fingerprint: rollout reads database.by_status.published, but production drafts can retain published_version and the key is absent when no current row status is published
defects.expected: baseline metrics include the public-material count derived from published_version, and rollout consumes that explicit metric

defects.title: Rollout requires a historical public clergy UUID absent from clean production
defects.bad_fingerprint: preflight requires one fixed Pavel UUID, version 8 and published status even though clean production correctly has zero published CMS materials
defects.expected: rollout preserves the baseline public count, derives an optional clergy pointer from actual production, compares it to the restore, and skips detail/contact checks when no such public records exist

defects.title: Rollout hard-codes an obsolete missing-media queue total
defects.bad_fingerprint: the verified restore contains 202 missing_media_issues from clean production while the old upgrade gate requires 201
defects.expected: baseline reports missing_media_issues and rollout preserves that signed count without a historical constant

defects.title: Baseline restart can activate a failed rollout image
defects.bad_fingerprint: a failed restore build retags the Compose image; the next baseline uses compose up, recreates production on that image and applies schema 14 before semantic rollout completes
defects.expected: baseline restarts the exact stopped container by ID, and stage 14 accepts schema 14 as an idempotent recovery source for the full semantic/post-activation gate

defects.title: Returning from a migration issue editor loses the issue-list context
defects.bad_fingerprint: the editor has no contextual return action and reopening Migration resets filters, pagination, position and focus
defects.expected: returning from the editor restores the applied issue filters, page, scroll position and originating row even after save

defects.title: Indexed and mirrored media totals are unreconciled
defects.bad_fingerprint: mirrored manifest count differs from physical file count
defects.expected: counts reconcile with classified delta
